>
[Echolocation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5493) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 77

**Archetype** [Werecreature](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=225)

**Prerequisites**
[Werecreature Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=5486); werebat

</column>

---

When you take the [Seek](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) action, you can use hearing as a [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn. You can also use this sense while you [Search](/Actions.aspx?ID=2677).
